description:
Let’s talk about the funnel neck, because chances are, you’ve already started seeing it.

With just a month of winter left (I'm definitely not counting down the days.. 😵‍💫😂 ) this neckline has been showing up on coats, jackets, and even vests and it’s here to stay as we head into spring. 

A funnel neck sits high and structured (without folding over like a roll neck), creating a clean, sculpted shape around the neck and shoulders, no scarf needed.

I’m using this khaki jacket to demonstrate what a funnel neck jacket might look like. The neckline adds instant structure and strikes the perfect balance between functional and styled.

It’s one of those subtle design updates that can instantly make your outfit feel modern.
